'''''Mine Mine Mine''''' was the private [[yacht skiff]]<ref name="Trammel" /> and [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]]<ref name="CSWE" /> of [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Rufus Trammel]], who used the vehicle to tour [[Dorumaa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of<ref name="Trammel" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Almas">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlfalmas|text=Almas}}</ref> [[Almas]]. After his bid on a private platform in<ref name="Trammel" /> the [[Genarius|Genarian]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="City">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlfgenarius|text=Genarius}}</ref> of [[Tolea Biqua]] became public during the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Trammel retreated to the ship. The yacht was rarely [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by Trammel himself, who regularly stood at the vessel's bow with his elbows on its railings.<ref name="Trammel" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Mine Mine Mine'' was first mentioned in "[[New Crimelord: Rufus Trammel]]," an article that was written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on their [[Wizards.com|website]] in [[2001]] as a tie-in to the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying campaign]].<ref name="Trammel" />
